scenes.title: Old intercom → Ring video doorbell
scenes.body: Same spot, same doorbell wires. Now they can see who's at the door from their phone.

scenes.title: A NuTone intercom speaker from another era
scenes.body: The old speaker box came off the brick.

scenes.title: Reuse the existing doorbell wires
scenes.body: The low-voltage wires were already there, so no new wiring through the wall.

scenes.title: Mounting bracket on the brick
scenes.body: Leveled, anchored into the masonry, and the wires connected.

scenes.title: Mounted, connected and ringing
scenes.body: Live view, motion alerts and two-way talk in the Ring app.
